description: Golden Corpus v1 - regression suite for LogicSim HDL export and simulation correctness, including fifteen Golden Corpus v2 pilot seeds

circuits.title: AND + OR + NOT chain

checkPoints.truthTable: y = NOT((a AND b) OR c)

circuits.rationale: Smallest combinational chain: covers AND/OR/NOT primitives and wire propagation through 3-gate DAG. Not in focused-nine.

circuits.title: Half Adder (XOR + AND fan-out)

checkPoints.truthTable: sum = a XOR b; carry = a AND b
checkPoints.fanOut: sw_a drives xor1 and and1; sw_b drives xor1 and and1

circuits.rationale: Fan-out from two inputs, two independent output paths. XOR coverage. Not in focused-nine.

circuits.title: SR-Latch (cross-coupled NOR)

checkPoints.semantics: S=1,R=0 → Q=1; S=0,R=1 → Q=0; S=0,R=0 → hold; S=1,R=1 → forbidden
checkPoints.vhdlShadow: w_0_q, w_1_q used for cross-coupled reads

circuits.rationale: Asynchronous latch: tests isSynchronous=false gate in HDL export, cross-coupled NOR pattern, shadow signal for both outputs. Not in focused-nine.

circuits.title: D-FF with async Set + Reset

checkPoints.verilogSens: posedge clk or posedge r or posedge s
checkPoints.internalWire: w_dut_q_n — q_n unconnected, assigned by toVerilog

circuits.rationale: D_FF_ASSR covers asyncSRWrapVerilog/VHDL with both S and R active (sc=null, rc=null — full 3-branch). Not in focused-nine.

circuits.title: JK-FF toggle mode (J=K=1 static)

checkPoints.semantics: J=K=1 → toggle on each CLK rising edge
vhdlBranches: j='1' and k='1' then not Q

circuits.rationale: JK_FF full 3-branch case (jc=null, kc=null). Toggle mode is a standard JK use case. Not in focused-nine.

circuits.title: 74HC74 Dual D-FF with Preset/Clear

checkPoints.verilogSens: posedge clk1 or negedge pre1 or negedge clr1
checkPoints.verilogWireOutputs: qn1, qn2 are assign wires; q1, q2 are regs

circuits.rationale: Dual FF with active-low preset/clear. Covers negedge sensitivity, two independent clock domains. Not in focused-nine (focused-nine uses hc373/374 tri-state, not 74HC74).

circuits.title: REG4 with clock enable

checkPoints.semantics: rst=1 → async clear all bits; en=1 + CLK↑ → load d0..d3

circuits.rationale: 4-bit register with EN: covers multi-output register, async reset, enable gating. Not in focused-nine.

circuits.title: Single TRIBUF — OE control
circuits.rationale: Simplest tri-state: single buffer, OE control. Baseline for Z-value output. Not in focused-nine.

circuits.title: Two-driver wired-OR bus (TRIBUF × 2)

checkPoints.wireMapNote: Two wires to same led:in — last wire (buf2:y=w_1) wins as output port; buf1:y=w_0 is orphan internal wire
checkPoints.hdlLimitation: buf1 output (w_0) is driven but not exported as output port — known exporter limitation for multi-driver tri-state
checkPoints.verilog: assign w_0 = (~oe1) ? a1 : 1'bz; assign w_1 = (~oe2) ? a2 : 1'bz

circuits.rationale: Validates exporter behavior for multi-driver bus: last-wire-wins byPort, orphan internal signal, no multi-driver guard triggered. Intentionally documents limitation.

circuits.title: Two D-FFs in series (pipeline stage)

checkPoints.pipeline: Output delays input by 2 clock cycles
checkPoints.clockFanOut: sw_clk drives both dff1:clk and dff2:clk
checkPoints.internalReg: w_0 is internal reg (dff1 output); w_1 is output reg (dff2 output)
checkPoints.shadowSignals: w_1_q shadow; dff1/dff2 q_n as internal wires

circuits.rationale: Multi-gate sequential: tests clock fan-out, internal reg declaration, sequential pipeline. Not in focused-nine (focused-nine has single DFF only).

circuits.title: 74HC283 4-bit adder (A=7, B=8 → S=15)

checkPoints.vhdl: process with unsigned arithmetic, sum_v(4 downto 0)

circuits.rationale: 74HC283 combinational IC: covers multi-output non-sequential IC, unsigned arithmetic export, 5-output shadow signal pattern. Not in focused-nine.

circuits.title: 74HC161 counter + AND gate (detect state 3)

checkPoints.semantics: AND(q0, q1) goes HIGH when counter reaches 3 (0b0011), and stays HIGH at 7 (0b0111), 11 (0b1011), 15 (0b1111)
checkPoints.vhdlExtraSignal: signal cnt_ctr : STD_LOGIC_VECTOR(3 downto 0) — vhdlExtraSignals mechanism
checkPoints.mixedGateFF: AND in gateLines + 74HC161 in ffLines — tests mixed combinational/sequential emit order

circuits.rationale: Counter feeding combinational logic: covers verilogExtraRegs, mixed gateLines+ffLines ordering, IC+primitive composition. Not in focused-nine.

circuits.title: D-FF basic clocking (both Q and Qn outputs)

checkPoints.semantics: D sampled on posedge CLK only; w_0=Q (reg), w_1=Qn (assign ~Q)
checkPoints.ffBlock: always @(posedge clk) begin w_0 <= d; end

circuits.rationale: D_FF with both Q and Qn as output ports: covers procDriven vs wire output classification, shadow signal pair generation in VHDL. GC-S1 from plan.

circuits.title: 74HC161 (async clear) vs 74HC163 (sync clear) side-by-side

checkPoints.semantics: 161: async clear via negedge clrn sensitivity; 163: sync clear inside rising_edge block only
checkPoints.verilogDiff: 161: always @(posedge clk or negedge clrn); 163: always @(posedge clk)
checkPoints.vhdlDiff: 161: process(clk, clrn) with if clrn='0' outside rising_edge; 163: process(clk) with clrn check inside rising_edge

circuits.rationale: Key distinguishing test: async vs sync clear in two counter variants. 16 shared signals plus separate cnt extra-regs. GC-S7 from plan (highest diagnostic value).

circuits.title: 74HC194 universal shift register — all 4 S1/S0 modes

checkPoints.semantics: S1S0=00 hold, 01 shift-right (sr in), 10 shift-left (sl in), 11 parallel load
checkPoints.verilogFFBlock: always @(posedge clk or negedge clrn) with case({s1,s0})
checkPoints.vhdlFFBlock: process(clk, clrn) with case STD_LOGIC_VECTOR'(s1 & s0)

circuits.rationale: 74HC194 universal shift register: covers all 4 operating modes, STD_LOGIC_VECTOR cast in VHDL case selector, verilogExtraRegs for shift register state. GC-S8 from plan.

circuits.title: 16-input selector fabric (dual 74HC151 banks + 74HC153 merge)
circuits.rationale: First v2 pilot seed: a larger combinational selector fabric that composes two 74HC151 banks with a 74HC153 merge stage. It stretches mux hierarchy and export determinism beyond the small v1 combinational cases.

circuits.title: ALU4 accumulator with phase counter
circuits.rationale: Second v2 pilot seed: a small datapath slice where a counter rotates the ALU opcode and a register captures the ALU output on each enabled clock edge. This adds multi-block composition and deeper temporal behavior beyond v1.

circuits.title: 74HC194 -> 74HC595 shift/latch pipeline
circuits.rationale: Fifth v2 pilot seed: a multi-IC sequential pipeline that parallel-loads a 74HC194, shifts shared-clock data into a 74HC595, and exposes latch plus tri-state behavior at the output stage. It extends the existing shift-register coverage into a longer trace with reset-to-known-state, latch isolation, and output-enable checks.

circuits.title: RAM256 readback path with REG8 capture

checkPoints.verilog: ram_ram[{a7, a6, a5, a4, a3, a2, a1, a0}] = {di7, di6, di5, di4, di3, di2, di1, di0}
checkPoints.vhdl: unsigned std_logic_vector a7 a6 a5 a4 a3 a2 a1 a0

circuits.rationale: Third v2 pilot seed: RAM256 feeds a REG8 through an observable live bus tap. It exercises async memory write/read, live tri-state bus behavior, and registered readback capture in one exportable circuit.

circuits.title: 74HC138 decode tree with 74HC373 hold tap and 74HC374 capture
circuits.rationale: Sixth v2 pilot seed: a decode tree where a 74HC138 fans out into both a 74HC373 hold path and a 74HC148 -> 74HC374 encoded capture path. This closes the gap around enable gating, hierarchical fanout, latch-vs-register behavior, and independent output-enable visibility in one composed reference circuit.

circuits.title: Custom half-adder hierarchy with raw full-adder oracle
circuits.rationale: Seventh v2 pilot seed and first hierarchical/custom-IC corpus case: the proven gc_c2_half_adder subcircuit is registered as a reusable custom IC, instantiated twice to form a full-adder path, and compared against a flat raw-gate oracle. This verifies one-level custom-IC registration, port mapping, repeated reuse, structural HDL flattening, and exact custom-vs-raw agreement.

circuits.title: Dual 74HC374 shared-bus conflict monitor
circuits.rationale: Fourth v2 pilot seed: two 74HC374 bus masters share a contested raw probe while paired REG4 shadows and decode logic expose stable conflict indicators. It documents the multi-driver boundary without making the portable HDL checks depend on raw X-resolution.

circuits.title: Three-stage feedback mesh with seed load and XOR feedback
circuits.rationale: Ninth v2 pilot seed: a three-stage sequential feedback mesh with an explicit seed-load phase, deterministic XOR feedback, and async reset. It stretches the corpus beyond pure pipeline/register cases by verifying a small state machine that can be seeded and then driven purely by its own previous outputs.

circuits.title: Dual REG4 custom-IC pipeline with one-cycle lag
circuits.rationale: Second v2 hierarchical/custom-IC seed: a reusable REG4 custom IC is instantiated twice as a pipeline pair, with a raw XOR tap comparing the delayed copies. This exercises custom-IC registration, flattening, enable/reset propagation, and staged state transfer without duplicating the half-adder case.

circuits.title: Custom TRIBUF hierarchy with preserved Z semantics
circuits.rationale: Third dedicated hierarchy/custom-IC seed: the proven tri-state direct path is wrapped as a reusable custom IC and exported again. This closes the gap around one-level hierarchy plus Z/high-impedance semantics, rather than only plain boolean outputs.

circuits.title: Custom 74HC194 hierarchy with hidden register state
circuits.rationale: Fourth dedicated hierarchy/custom-IC seed: the existing 74HC194 modes circuit is wrapped as a reusable custom IC and re-exported. This verifies one-level sequential hierarchy for a gate with hidden state, async clear, multiple modes, and extra HDL register declarations.

circuits.title: Direct nested custom half-adder parent with raw OR oracle
circuits.rationale: Twelfth v2 pilot seed and first Golden-Corpus case with a directly nested combinational custom-IC parent: a registered HALF_ADDER is wrapped into a reusable PARENT_HALF_ADDER custom IC, then compared against a raw OR oracle at top level. This verifies direct nested custom-IC registration order, recursive structural HDL flattening, and exact nested-vs-raw agreement.

circuits.title: Deep nested custom half-adder grandparent stays blocked at the current rollout boundary

checkPoints.verilog: HDL EXPORT BLOCKED — Error: Nested custom IC "CIC_PARENT_HALF_ADDER" already contains its own custom IC hierarchy.
checkPoints.vhdl: HDL EXPORT BLOCKED — Error: Nested custom IC "CIC_PARENT_HALF_ADDER" already contains its own custom IC hierarchy.

circuits.rationale: Thirteenth v2 pilot seed and first deeper hierarchy boundary case: a GRANDPARENT_HALF_ADDER custom IC wraps PARENT_HALF_ADDER, which already wraps HALF_ADDER. Runtime recursion remains possible, but HDL export must stay blocked at this rollout stage. This keeps the current deeper-than-direct nested boundary explicit and regression-checked instead of silently drifting.

circuits.title: Extended mixed datapath with counter, ALU4 and REG4 over reset, hold and mode changes
circuits.rationale: Fourteenth v2 pilot seed and first larger state-heavy system promoted from the focused regression set into the Golden Corpus: a BIN_CTR7S drives an ALU4 whose result is captured by REG4. The case verifies chained sequential/combinational interaction over reset, repeated clock edges, disabled hold and ALU mode changes, so it catches datapath timing and capture regressions that a shorter two-cycle smoke scenario would miss.

circuits.title: RAM256 decode-and-bit-select bus with latch hold and REG4 capture
circuits.rationale: Fifteenth v2 pilot seed and first larger integrated bus-/memory-/decode system in the Golden Corpus: RAM256 feeds both a direct live bus tap and a 74HC151 bit-select path, a 74HC138 exposes address decode status, a 74HC373 proves transparent-vs-held memory observation, and REG4 captures the combined status over reset and clock edges. This closes the gap between isolated RAM, decode, and bus cases by checking them together as one reproducible system path.
